n: The shortest psalm and shortest chapter in the Bible has a huge reach: every nation and every people is called to praise Israel’s God. Paul quotes it to show the gospel is for Gentiles too.
Two reasons: God’s covenant love toward us is mighty, and his faithfulness lasts forever. Hallelujah!

f.g: Hebrew ḥesed — steadfast covenant love; ‘great’ also means ‘prevailing, mighty.’
